title: Realistic Berry Cluster
description: Replaces the Sweet Berry item texture with a high-definition, photorealistic cluster of berries.
body:
🍓 Realistic Berry Cluster (Sweet Berry Item Texture) – 1024×1024 Resolution

A cosmetic resource pack created for the Z.XP Collection.

This resource pack replaces the default low-resolution Sweet Berry item texture with a detailed, high-resolution 1024×1024 texture, designed to provide a more realistic and visually appealing appearance. This pack is purely aesthetic and does not affect gameplay mechanics.

✨ Features & Project Details

- Replacement Target: Sweet Berry item texture only ("sweet_berries.png").
- Resolution: 1024×1024.
- Resource Pack Type: Purely cosmetic and visual enhancement.
- Purpose: To provide a more realistic and immersive visual experience while preserving the original functionality of the item.

⚠️ Known Issues & Planned Improvements

Visual Rendering Issues

You may occasionally notice minor spacing artifacts or empty pixels around the item texture. These visual issues are related to the way Minecraft renders certain item models.

- Recommended Solution: If you encounter these artifacts, consider using the Model Gap Fix mod:
  https://modrinth.com/mod/modelfix

- Future Updates: We are actively working to eliminate these rendering issues and improve visual consistency in future releases.

Held Item Position

The appearance and positioning of the item while held in the player's hand may not be fully optimized yet. This will be refined and improved in future updates.

📩 Support, Updates & Custom Requests

If you encounter any issues not listed above, please report them so they can be investigated and fixed.

We also offer FREE custom resource pack requests. If you would like:

- an update for this resource pack,
- additional items added to this project,
- or a completely new high-resolution cosmetic resource pack,

please contact us directly via email:
